invariants.rule: Every authoritative SQLite connection is created by the SOMA connection factory and proves foreign-key enforcement before authoritative use.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Attempt every supported access path with FK enforcement disabled/misconfigured and require fail-closed behavior.

invariants.rule: No ordinary application/import/job/test/maintenance path may disable referential enforcement or bypass the owned persistence boundary.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Static/integration checks detect unmanaged connection/write paths.

invariants.rule: Every effective child-side foreign-key access path has an effective supporting index or an explicit measured/validated exception.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Machine-verify FK-to-index coverage after each migration and restore.

invariants.rule: Migration schema/data changes and their ledger/version evidence publish atomically under one exclusive migrator.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Failure injection at every migration phase cannot expose schema-without-ledger or ledger-without-schema state.

invariants.rule: Once accepted, migration identity/order/canonical content/checksum/manifest evidence is immutable; non-disposable data is corrected forward only.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Accepted migration byte drift or ledger mismatch blocks readiness rather than being rewritten to match.

invariants.rule: Authoritative readiness is impossible until migration, exact schema, FK and required integrity/append-only checks pass.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Corrupt/drifted/future/incomplete states never produce a ready host.

invariants.rule: Migration status is observational: requesting it cannot create or mutate the database, directory, sidecars, ledger, settings, diagnostics, or runtime state merely by inspection.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Filesystem/database before-and-after snapshots are identical for status against missing/current/error targets.

invariants.rule: Long external/file work and operator think-time never hold an authoritative SQLite write transaction open.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Import/mail/bulk/review tests prove parsing/review occurs outside write transactions and stale state is revalidated before commit.

invariants.rule: Every accepted command publishes all required authoritative state atomically or none of it; partial domain/audit/event publication is forbidden.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Injected constraint/audit/disk errors roll back the complete command boundary.

invariants.rule: Persisted JSON belongs to named/versioned bounded contracts and cannot become generic domain storage or silently discard unknown structure.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Malformed, duplicate-key, nonfinite, oversized, unknown-version, and unknown-field-policy vectors behave deterministically without fallback serialization.

invariants.rule: Reading settings/documents/status does not create defaults or otherwise mutate authoritative state.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Pure-read tests verify missing values remain missing until an explicit write command.

invariants.rule: Technical diagnostics, runtime registry, client state, caches, and projections are non-authoritative and cannot replace relational domain/lifecycle/audit truth.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Delete/rebuild disposable technical state and verify canonical domain state remains intact.

invariants.rule: A rebuildable projection owns no unique fact and accepts no independent authoritative mutation.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Projection rebuild from canonical state reproduces its authoritative-facing output.

invariants.rule: Crash, cancellation, disk/constraint failure, or process interruption leaves SQLite at the last committed authoritative state.
invariants.acceptance_hook: Restart/retry failure-injection tests converge from the last committed boundary without duplicate committed migrations or partial commands.

invariants.rule: Restore candidates are not published until migration-lineage/schema/FK/integrity checks pass; failed restore validation leaves the prior valid data instance unchanged.
